newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures end lower across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures end lower across the board.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed lower across the board on Wednesday, reflecting weaker sentiment in CBOT overnight corn trading, traders said.
Prices were 140 to 470 yen lower, with the benchmark March 1998 contract down 390 yen at 16,300 yen per tonne. The day's volume was 48,875 lots.
The market opened steady to lower on technical selling from local investors, traders said.
"Investors were also discouraged by the weaker soybean market," a brokerage house trader said.
The spot May contract on CBOT Project A was trading at $3.11-1/2 per bushel at 0800 GMT, down from $3.13 at Tuesday's close.
Spot May CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system were at $8.72 per bushel, down from $8.75-1/2 at Tuesday's close.
